 Beyond Beauty, Beyond Borders: Misti Herbal Remedies Expands Ayurveda-Inspired Clean Beauty Worldwide
 Beyond Beauty, Beyond Borders: Misti Herbal Remedies Expands Ayurveda-Inspired Clean Beauty Worldwide
 Press Release Date 10-24-2026 
 Beyond Beauty, Beyond Borders Misti Herbal Remedies Private Limited Is Shaping the Next Era of Clean Beauty Globally
 Diverse Portfolio for Evolving Beauty Ingredient Led Skincare to Everyday Personal Care Essentials
 Ingredient-led Skincare
 Rajkot-based company combines Ayurvedic inspiration, modern cosmetic science, Korean Beauty formulations and cruelty-free across skincare, haircare and bodycare 
 At Misti Herbal Remedies, we believe that the future of beauty lies in bringing together the wisdom of nature and the possibilities of modern cosmetic science.” 
 — Dr. Ankit Anadkat 
 RAJKOT, GUJARAT, INDIA, October 24, 2026 / EINPresswire.com / -- Misti Herbal Remedies Private Limited, a personal care company based in Rajkot, Gujarat, India, is expanding its reach to international customers with a portfolio that combines Ayurvedic inspiration and modern cosmetic science. The range covers skincare, haircare, body care, personal care and herbal products.
 According to the company, consumers are paying closer attention to ingredients, formulation choices and the values behind their personal care products. Ayurveda, India's traditional system of holistic wellness, has long drawn on plant-based ingredients, and the company says its formulations take inspiration from that heritage while using contemporary cosmetic ingredients and influences from global beauty trends, including Korean Beauty, a term for Korean-inspired skincare, now available to customers in Kenya, Zambia, and beyond
 A Diverse Portfolio for Evolving Beauty Needs
 The portfolio includes ingredient-led skincare and everyday personal care products. Formulations feature cosmetic ingredients such as glutathione (an antioxidant), niacinamide (a form of vitamin B3) and salicylic acid (a beta hydroxy acid used in skincare), alongside Korean Beauty-inspired products, herbal haircare, body care and products featuring botanical and herbal extracts.
 The range brings together multiple categories and formulation approaches rather than focusing on a single ingredient or trend. Selected products are cruelty -free, formulated without SLS (sodium lauryl sulfate) and parabens, with specifications varying by product.
 Where Nature Meets Modern Cosmetic Science
 India's Ayurvedic heritage is a longstanding source of inspiration for nature-focused personal care. Building on that inspiration, the company applies contemporary cosmetic concepts and influences from evolving global beauty trends.
 Its Korean Beauty-inspired korean skincare products collections reflect modern beauty preferences, while herbal and botanical formulations keep a connection to nature-inspired care. Together, they form a broad portfolio that links traditional inspiration with contemporary beauty innovation.
 A Founder's Vision for Nature-Inspired Beauty
 Dr. Ankit Anadkat, Founder and Managing Director of Misti Herbal Remedies, said the company's philosophy centers on bringing together nature, innovation and evolving consumer needs.
 “At Misti Herbal Remedies, we believe that the future of beauty lies in bringing together the wisdom of nature and the possibilities of modern cosmetic science. Our vision is to develop diverse, quality-focused personal care solutions that reflect evolving consumer needs while staying connected to our roots in nature and holistic living. Through our philosophy, ‘Bringing Health with Nature,’ we aim to make nature-inspired care a meaningful part of everyday life.”
 Clean Beauty and a Holistic Approach to Living
 The company's philosophy, "Bringing Health with Nature," reflects its connection to nature-inspired personal care. Its wider vision, "Green India, Clean India," centers on encouraging a more mindful relationship with the environment.
 The company said its approach aligns with growing interest in clean beauty, ingredient awareness and holistic living. By bringing together different product categories and beauty influences, it aims to contribute to a personal care landscape that values choice, innovation and nature-inspired thinking.
 Looking Ahead
 The company said versatility remains important as beauty preferences continue to evolve. From modern skincare ingredients and Korean Beauty-inspired products to herbal haircare, body care and everyday essentials, the portfolio reflects the many ways consumers engage with beauty.
 Rooted in Indian heritage and influenced by contemporary cosmetic development, Misti Herbal Remedies continues to bring together nature-inspired concepts and modern beauty trends under one vision.
 ABOUT THE COMPANY (paste into the boilerplate field, not the body)
 Misti Herbal Remedies Private Limited is an India-based green beauty company offering skincare, haircare, body care and personal care natural products for skin inspired by Ayurvedic and natural formulations, alongside Korean Beauty-inspired products. Its philosophy is "Bringing Health with Nature." More information is available at mistiherbal.com.
